![](images/19/192cd7673f9186480bd6ab9955e56eab78b8a4e3bbec9d8d824922b5fd9c0527.png)

The area of ​​the triangle $△ABC$ is $\frac{15\sqrt{3}}{2}cm^{2}$. Determine $m∠A$.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The area formula gives $$\tfrac12(5)(6)\sin A=\tfrac{15\sqrt3}{2}\implies\sin A=\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}.$$ The marked angle is acute in the given diagram, selecting $A=60^\circ$ rather than its obtuse supplement.
